question: Where are all the named sacred sites ultimately located?
premises: Mountain tops, riverbanks, and solitary liṅgas were named as sacred places.
The text dismisses the need to multiply external examples.
All of them are said to be in consciousness and present in prāṇa.
inference: The entire outer sacred geography is ultimately internalized in consciousness and prāṇa.
plain_english: Mountain tops, riverbanks, and solitary liṅgas—why say more? All of that is in consciousness and present in prāṇa.
